25:34) --- Page 5 --- KRISTOKO DAKSNINGANI (Imitation of Christ) Peskagipa : FR.A.BUCCIERI, S.D.B.
1991 DON BOSCO PUBLICATIIONS GUWAHATI 781001 Available at DON BOSCO BOOK CENTRE TURA --- Page 6 --- IMPRIMATUR G.MAMALASSERI Bishop of Tura 19-3-1991 Fest of St.
Joseph TURY Ist Edition 1987-3000copics Reprint 1991-3000copics Don Bosco Publicutions Catulogue Card No.
G.91-068 DD 1 Don Bosco Technical School Shillong 793 003 --- Page 7 --- This book helong tn Gor?
AGANSOANI Sastroni kitaprangko changija, pilek Kristan searangni gisepo.
De imitatione Christi-Kristokd daksningani ine minggipa kitap pangnan ming- singbataha aro uko pile pile tariaha aro chepa kaataha.
Uko pilak kusikrangchi -ongnasipile peaha.
Sawa uko scaha aro mai bilsio, daona king- king talbreja.
Mingsinggipa kitap .kingsa ongani gimin, mitam Rt.
Augustin (354-430) ba Rt.
Ansclm(1033/1509)baRt.Bcrnard (1090/1155) uko seaha ine aganaha.
Indiba uamang uko se- chongmotjalha.
Sechenggipa lckkarang gimaaha.
Uarangko Latin kusikchi seahachim.
Bonga, Kempis-oni Thomas(ThomasaKcmpis)(1380-1471), Holland asongni Certosin soinasi saksa uko scaha ine bebcraaha aro skiaha.
Indibasandienioa daororo bangbatan uko John Jersen sechong- motaha ine agana.
John Jersen 1224-bilsioni 1240 bilsiona A.
Vercelli songo (Italyo) Rt.
Stephen-ni Benedectin soinasirangni pamong ongaha.
Mitam mitamara ia kitap mande saksanisan seani ongja ine beberaa.
Saoba saoba dingtang dingtang seanirangko kadime kitap kingsako tariaha ine agana.
--- Page 8 --- Kitapko tarigipa skianirang aro didianirangko soinasirangna aro antangtangko Isolna onkang- giparangna seaha.
Indiba Kristan sakantian baptismako rae Isol- ni de ongpila.
Indide gipin Kristo saksa gita ongna aro Kristoko daksningna joton kana nanga.
Uni gimin Kristoko daksningani-ni skianirang pilak Kristoko jarikgiparangna gamchatbegipa onga.
Rongtale tangna, antangko naimatrorona aro Isolni mikkango chusokgipa Kristan ong- na, ia kitapko poraie chanchibewalgipa banga dakchakaniko mana.
Ia kitapni pilak skianirang Sastroosa pang- chaka.
Mingsingbegipa Bishop aro Skigipa saksa, Bossuet (1627-1704) Kristoko Daksningani kitap bongagipa Nama Katta onga ine aganrongachim.
Ia kitapo bak mingbri ba kitap king bri donga.
Mande Isol baksa nangrimna pilakna skangan antangko rongtalatna nanga (Via Purgativa).
Sagipa bako iako skia.
Iani gimin ua antangko onatchina (odhai 2) aro bebekosa rachake (odhai 3), antangni daka- rangna simsakchina (4).
Isolni kattao pangchake (5) mikbokanirangko (6), rasongko amaniko (7), ramram ripeng dakaniko gelchina (8).
Unon chu- batgiparangna bamchina (9), belbelako gelchina (10), antangko jechakchina (11), nenganirangko aro dakmajoanirangko chakchikchina.
--- Page 9 --- Ia rongtalatani kamo reanggipa chasongrangni toromirangni dakmesokanirang kadongataniko ona (odhai 18).
Uandaken mande pap kengnigipa kam onga (21), Isolsan anchingko katchaata (22), sina nanggcn (23) aro bichal kaako mangen (24) ine gisik rac, gital mande ongna (25) joton kagen.
Antangko rongtalatmano mande maiko dake maiko gele Isol baksa nangrimgen, iako masina aro chanchina nanga.
Chongmotan ua tengstlutcko nanga (Via illuminativa).
Kitapni gnigipa bak iako skia aro mesoka.
Ua gisikni jakgitel onganiko nanga (odhai 1) nenganirangko aro jajrenganirangko chakchikna (2) aro tomtomaniko amna nanga (3).
lani gimin grang gegniko nanga (4), je sronggipa niksong- ani (5-6)aro rongtala namnikaniko,chonginotan ua pilakna bate Isolko (7) aro Unbaksa 1ipeng dakako (8) gamchatnikbata.
Mongsongde ua chisolni ramako ree Jisu baksa antangni chisolko ripepana nanga (11-12).
Iako masie mande Isol baksa nangrimna mana (Via unitiva).
Kitapni gitamgipa bako iako mesoka.
Ua gisik nange aro one Isolni kattako knatima (odhai 1-2-3), kakket dake Isolna dangdike ona (4) aro katong gimikchi Isolna kasaa (5-6-7-8-9).
Jisuko jarikna okamahana ua Isolko mitela (10) aro mamanti dakgnirangko chusokate (odhai 11-oni 20-ona) Isolosa nengtaka aro suk mana (21-22).
VII --- Page 10 --- Gipin odhairango kitap segipa gisik senggipa aro bimchipbegipa sninggipa antangko namatro- roe salgini sukko chatotsoa aro chusokgipa tom- tomaniko mana ine skia.
Agilsako Isol baksa nangrimna nambatsrang- gipa chol Rt.
Eukaristia onga.
Mande kraa gita ia Sakramentko rae, Isolko katongtango nok- chaka.
Kitapni brigipa bak ia sakramentni dala- ko, gamchatako aro bilko gisik raata.
Achik Kristanrangba ia kitapko poraie gisik nangbate Kristoko jarikgen aro bimchipbate Una dangdike ongen ine beberae, anga Latin kusikoni- ko uko Achik kusikchi pena joton kaaha.
Ia kamo Pa.
Jonathon Bangshall (Tila Pa) angni peako srongate aro namate angko namen dakchakaha aro anga uko mitelbea.
Pitor ongchenggipa Kristanrangna seaha gita, Isol "Gitel aro Jokatgipa Jisuni Kristoni kasara aro uianio bilakrorochina" (1I Pit.
3:18) anchingko dakchakchina.
Fr.A.BUCCIERI,S.D.B.
3rd Dec.1986 Feast of St.
Francis Xavier Patron of the Missions IIIA
